what: Amends 00859 item 2: the Job field's type is now `pub(crate) pure: Box<[OnceLock<script::pure::Purity>]>` (not `OnceLock<Option<Pure>>`), same initialisation. Also, where a run's BuildScriptRan is made, once lane ci's `BuildScriptRan.purity` exists (request from pure-scripts-measure), fill it from `script::pure::reported(job, run)`.
